children: Completion of the Acquisition of GEM Newco Limited

EARNZ plc ("EARNZ" or the "Company") (AIM: EARN), an energy services company whose objective is to capitalise on the drive for global decarbonisation, announces that, further to the announcement today at 7:00 a.m, completion of the acquisition of GEM Newco Limited and the associated admission of 218,146,725 new ordinary shares is expected to take place tomorrow, 21 October 2026.
